storylines.latest_title: LongSearchEval: Evaluating Long-Horizon Web Search Capabilities of Large Language Models via a Trajectory-Aware Agent Framework with Failure-Node Localization

prior_narrative.tldr: DeepSeek said on Oct 20 it is open-sourcing DeepInfer, the software that serves its production models. Coverage first framed it as a way to cut AI operating costs, then as pressure on OpenAI and Anthropic.
prior_narrative.whats_new: No new DeepInfer coverage since Oct 21; Oct 22-26 items (agent evals, multi-agent and web-search papers) are unrelated and the efficiency claims remain unreproduced.
prior_narrative.why_it_matters: A production-proven open inference stack gives platform teams a reference for serving cost and throughput that vLLM-style deployments can be benchmarked against.

status.detail: DeepInfer is public; independent reproduction of the efficiency claims has not appeared yet.

open_questions: Does an independent benchmark reproduce the 155T tokens/day and ~80% margin figures?
Which hardware backends does DeepInfer support outside DeepSeek's own clusters?
Which license terms govern commercial reuse of DeepInfer?
prior_narrative.take_for_builders: Read the DeepInfer repo and license before changing a serving stack; treat the margin figures as unverified until someone reproduces them on non-DeepSeek hardware.
